WhyUs.heading: We don't just make invitations — we create keepsakes
WhyUs.intro: Every handmade invitation starts from a blank page, just for you. We draw your church, your details and your story — a wedding, christening or slava invitation you won't find anywhere else.

reasons.title: As unique as you are
reasons.text: We never use ready-made templates. Every design is an original illustration, drawn for your family and your day alone.

reasons.title: Love in every last detail
reasons.text: From the choice of handmade paper, through gilded edges and a wax seal, to the final finishing — every single piece passes through our hands. Because love shows in the small things.

reasons.title: A family atelier
reasons.text: Behind every order stand the two of us, and three little ones who remind us daily how precious family moments are. We ship across Serbia, to Bosnia and Montenegro — and treat every celebration as if it were our own.

Gallery.heading: Hand-illustrated invitations for days worth remembering
Gallery.subheading: Every wedding, christening or slava invitation is designed for you alone — no templates, with carefully chosen details that tell your story.

details.desc: Gifts, décor and everything that keeps your most beautiful stories.

About.heading: Behind every illustration
About.text:
We are a small team turning your most beautiful moments into hand-painted art. Every invitation begins with a blank page and your story — your church, the two of you — and becomes something no one else has.

What began as invitations grew into art and gifts for life's dearest occasions.

Contact.heading: Let's create yours
Contact.text: Have a question, or ready to begin? Write to us — we reply quickly and gladly.

ArtPage.heading: Art that keeps what matters
ArtPage.intro: Handmade illustrations inspired by Orthodox faith, family and Serbian tradition — slava gifts and framed keepsakes made to grace a home for years and be passed on with love.
ArtPage.empty: Pieces coming soon. For inquiries, message us on Instagram.

DodaciPage.heading: What makes memories last
DodaciPage.intro: From gifts for the koum and guests, through thank-you cards and welcome signs, to decorative details — all designed so your most important day stays remembered.

PrilagoditePage.heading: Make it yours
PrilagoditePage.intro: Want something entirely your own? We create fully custom invitations to your vision, as well as special forms — folded invitations, invitations in a bottle and other one-of-a-kind ideas. Browse the examples, then reach out and we'll design yours.

Nastanak.heading: The making
Nastanak.intro: See how each invitation and art piece comes to life — from the first sketch to the finished, hand-painted work.
